rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A web search and content extraction MCP server that combines SearXNG search with advanced information retrieval techniques. Runs a local SearXNG instance via Docker for privacy-focused searching, then applies BM25 scoring and heuristic ranking to extract the most relevant content snippets from scraped pages. Features sophisticated deduplication, citation filtering, and configurable extraction budgets.
